typography.strategy: High-contrast authoritative sans-serif pairing. Outfit provides geometric, modern, premium headings while IBM Plex Sans guarantees maximum legibility for dense B2B data grids.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing + Control Room Grid. Data density must be balanced with breathing room. Cards should use p-6 or p-8 padding.

surfaces.card: bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden

motion_and_interactions.philosophy: Elegant, swift, purposeful motion. No sluggish animations. <=300ms duration. B2B tools should feel performant and responsive.

buttons.primary: inline-flex items-center justify-center px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-lg text-white bg-[#EA580C] hover:bg-[#C2410C] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-[#EA580C] transition-colors
buttons.secondary: inline-flex items-center justify-center px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-lg text-gray-700 bg-white border border-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-[#EA580C] transition-colors
buttons.ghost: inline-flex items-center justify-center px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-lg text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100 transition-colors

inputs.base: block w-full rounded-lg border-gray-300 shadow-sm focus:border-[#EA580C] focus:ring-[#EA580C] sm:text-sm transition-shadow
inputs.label: block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1

components_strategy.tables: Use Shadcn Table. Wrap in card. Add subtle hover states on rows (`hover:bg-gray-50`). Header text should be overline style.
components_strategy.tabs: Shadcn Tabs. Customize active state to use primary brand color underline or pill, not generic gray.

login_hero.description: Abstract 3D geometric shapes in vibrant orange hues. Use this for the hero side panel on the login page to create a premium, non-generic, artistic SaaS feel.

media.instructions_to_main_agent: Only use the provided media URLs. For avatars, use ui-avatars.com or simple SVG initials. Do not use generic placeholders.

login.layout: Split screen (50/50). Left side: Form. Right side: Hero illustration.
login.visuals: Use `login_hero` image on the right panel with a subtle overlay (`bg-[#111827]/10`). Animate the image in with a slow scale effect. The form should use the `glass` surface style if layered, or crisp white if separate.
login.interactions: Staggered reveal of form inputs and button.

dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation (dark #111827). Main content area (gray-50). Top row: 4 KPI Cards. Main row: Webinars Table (col-span-8) + Quick Actions/Activity (col-span-4).
dashboard.interactions: Cards slide up and fade in staggeredly. Hover states on KPI cards lift slightly. Table rows have subtle background transition.

webinar_detail.layout: Breadcrumbs -> Header (Title + Status + Actions). 3 Tabs: Send Plan, Registrants, Lead Magnets. Right sidebar or top bento box for 'ShowUp Score'.
webinar_detail.interactions: Each touch/action in the Send Plan is a separate card. Animate tab content switches using Framer Motion `AnimatePresence`.

approval_queue.layout: List of 'Touch Cards'. Each card bundles an email preview + social caption.
approval_queue.interactions: Swipe or button-click to approve/reject. When approved, card animates out (slides right/fades) and list collapses smoothly.

analytics.layout: Control room grid. Large charts (Recharts) for attendance over time, conversion rates.
analytics.visuals: Chart strokes should use brand colors (#EA580C, #111827). Tooltips must be custom styled to match brand.

settings.layout: Two-column layout (sidebar nav for settings categories, main content for forms). Long forms broken into distinct provider sections (e.g., Zoom, LinkedIn, SMTP) enclosed in cards.

ad_hoc_post_generator_modal.layout: Shadcn Dialog/Modal. Wide. Left side: Input context/parameters. Right side: Output preview.
ad_hoc_post_generator_modal.interactions: User clicks 'Generate'. Show a bespoke loading animation (e.g., pulsing skeleton blocks or a rotating brand icon). Then reveal the generated LinkedIn post + image + poll with a slide-up animation. Must feel magical.
